channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Age of Wonders 4: Archon Prophecy
item.description: Take command of the forces of light in the Age of Wonders 4: Archon Prophecy expansion!Join the celestial Archons as they strike back against Urrath’s corrupt forces. Contains new forms and culture, four new tomes, and Prophecy events.

item.title: Age of Wonders 4: Giant Kings
item.description: Restore the Elder Giants as rulers of the Astral Sea in the Age of Wonders 4: Giant Kings expansion. Explore the ruins of their fallen empire and delve for forgotten treasures beneath the earth. Includes a new giant ruler type, dwelling, and hand-crafted regions.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - A Nightmare on Elm Street™
item.description: A Nightmare on Elm Street is a Chapter for Dead by Daylight. It includes a new Killer, a Survivor and a Map. Who would have thought that dreams could actually do harm? Physical, pain inducing harm? Fear and pain stemming from a scarred soul who seeks revenge for a punishment he deserved.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Alan Wake Chapter
item.description: From one Dark Place to another. Dead by Daylight: Alan Wake brings bestselling author Alan Wake into The Fog. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive universal Charm: Nail Gun.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Alien Chapter Pack
item.description: Dead by Daylight’s Alien Chapter brings two iconic characters into The Fog: new Killer the Xenomorph and new Survivor Ellen Ripley. A new Map, Nostromo Wreckage, is available for all players. This Chapter Pack unlocks the Motion Tracker Charm, as well as the Very Rare Back in Action outfit for Ellen Ripley.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - All Things Wicked Chapter
item.description: Dead by Daylight’s All Things Wicked delves into the depths of analog horror with new Killer, The Unknown, and new Survivor, Sable Ward. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Unknown’s Garden Casual and Sable Ward’s Designer Corset.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Ash vs Evil Dead
item.description: Ash Williams, the legendary hero from the Ash vs Evil Dead horror series, has entered the realm of the Entity. While this time the chainsaw is not his to wield, Ash knows how to escape gruesome death. Wander through The Fog as Ash and escape evil once more.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Castlevania Chapter
item.description: So comes the very night incarnate, accursed and ravenous. Dead by Daylight: Castlevania brings Dracula and Trevor Belmont into The Fog. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Charm: Vampire Killer.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Chucky Chapter
item.description: Meet your new best friend ‘til the end. Dead by Daylight: Chucky brings an iconic horror legend into The Fog with a new Killer: The Good Guy - Chucky. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Charm: Good Guys Box.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Doomed Course
item.description: Embark on Dead by Daylight’s Doomed Course with new Killer, The Houndmaster, and new Survivor, Taurie Cain. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Houndmaster’s Titanium Skull and Taurie Cain’s Gold Tier.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Dungeons & Dragons
item.description: Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons brings the realm of fantasy horror into The Fog with new Killer, Vecna and new Survivors Aestri Yazar and Baermar Uraz (one character with 2 playable options). A new Map, Forgotten Ruins, is available for all players.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - End Transmission Chapter
item.description: Dead by Daylight’s End Transmission Chapter features a new Killer – The Singularity – and a new Survivor, Gabriel Soma. A new Map, Toba Landing, is available for all players. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Singularity’s Curved Scythe and Gabriel’s Illuminated Shirt.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Endless Hunt Pack
item.description: Fear follows in the Endless Hunt Pack, which includes 9 playable characters from 4 of Dead by Daylight’s most ruthless Chapters yet: Portrait of a Murder, Roots of Dread, Forged in Fog, and Tools of Torment.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Escape Expansion Pack
item.description: Will you be a leader? A hero? An escape artist? The Escape Expansion Pack gives you access to 12 original characters to discover and explore.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Ghost Face®
item.description: Ghost Face is a brand-new Killer for Dead by Daylight. the Ghost Face DLC unlocks its new Killer and exclusive items for the new killer.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Leatherface™
item.description: Leatherface is a Character DLC for Dead by Daylight. This is slaughter in its purest form. A kind of slaughter driven by a pure need of flesh. Leatherface won’t fail and he won’t stop. As the chainsaw starts, you know what is coming. You will end up on someone’s plate.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Macabre Tales Pack
item.description: Tragedy strikes in the Macabre Tales Pack, which includes 7 playable characters from 4 of Dead by Daylight’s most experimental Chapters yet: Descend Beyond, A Binding of Kin, All-Kill, and Hour of The Witch.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Maddening Darkness Pack
item.description: Danger lurks in the Maddening Darkness Pack, which includes 8 playable characters from 4 of Dead by Daylight’s most twisted Chapters yet: Of Flesh And Mud, Spark Of Madness, Curtain Call, and Shattered Bloodline.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Nicolas Cage Chapter Pack
item.description: Prepare for a tour de force performance. Dead by Daylight’s Nicolas Cage Chapter Pack features a new Survivor, legendary actor Nicolas Cage in his deadliest role yet. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Cosmetic: Teal Jacket as well as the Very Rare Gorgon Drip outfit for Nicolas Cage.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Old Wounds Pack
item.description: Pain awaits in the Old Wounds Pack, which includes 8 playable characters from 4 of Dead by Daylight’s most unforgiving Chapters yet: Darkness Among Us, Demise of the Faithful, Cursed Legacy, and Chains of Hate.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Sadako Rising Chapter
item.description: Sadako Rising features a new Killer – The Onryō – and a new Survivor, Yoichi Asakawa. Purchasing this add-on also unlocks an exclusive charm: Cursed Videotape.

item.title: Dead By Daylight - Silent Hill Chapter
item.description: Silent Hill is a new Chapter for Dead by Daylight. It includes a Killer, The Executioner; a Survivor, Cheryl Mason; and a map. Purchasing the add-on will unlock its new Killer, new Survivor, and an exclusive universal Charm.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Sinister Grace
item.description: Play as The Krasue, a gruesome Killer with two terrifying forms, or Vee Boonyasak, an electrifying survivor from the rising punk band Axekick. Experience a terrifying take on Thai Folklore rooted in visceral body-horror....in Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Steady Pulse
item.description: Dead by Daylight’s Steady Pulse includes a new Survivor, Orela Rose onto the scene. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Cosmetic: Black and White Blazer.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Terror Expansion Pack
item.description: There’s more than one way to sacrifice a Survivor. The Terror Expansion Pack gives you access to 11 original characters to explore and unleash.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - The Saw® Chapter
item.description: The Saw Chapter is a Chapter for Dead by Daylight. It includes a new Killer, The Pig, a Survivor, David Tapp, and a Map.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Tokyo Ghoul
item.description: Dead by Daylight’s Tokyo Ghoul includes a new Killer, Ken Kaneki. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Ken Kaneki badge and the Red Spider Lilies banner.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Tomb Raider Chapter
item.description: Descend into the deepest corners of the unexplored. Dead by Daylight: Tomb Raider brings iconic new survivor Lara Croft into The Fog. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Charm: Climbing Axe.

item.title: Demonic Mahjong
item.description: Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!

item.title: Hooked on You: A Dead by Daylight Dating Sim™
item.description: Welcome to Murderer’s Island. Your companions: four dead-sexy Killers who, underneath their murderous exteriors, just want a little romance. Flirt your way into their hearts, uncovering dark twists along the way. Will you find true love, forge friendships… or get hacked to death?

item.title: Killing Floor 3
item.description: It’s 2091 and megacorp Horzine has produced the ultimate army: an obedient horde of bioengineered monsters called zeds. Now, join the rebel group Nightfall in this co-op action/horror FPS that puts you and your teammates in a battle for the future of humanity.

item.title: Kotama and Academy Citadel
item.description: In the Academy Citadel, strength reigns supreme: only the most powerful survive and thrive. Fight your way through the high-tech Academy in your quest to get the highest of honors for a student, and uncover secrets that can save it in its direst crisis in this 2.5D side-scrolling Metroidvania.

item.title: Moving Out
item.description: Moving Out is a ridiculous physics-based moving simulator that brings new meaning to "couch co-op"! Are you ready for an exciting career in furniture? As a newly certified Furniture Arrangement & Relocation Technician, you’ll take on moving jobs all across the busy town of Packmore.

item.title: Moving Out 2
item.description: Moving Out is back and wackier than ever, and now with ONLINE PLAY! Return to Packmore and use your moving skills across brand new dimensions and some old favourites. Help rebuild Smooth Moves and become an all-star F.A.R.T. (Furniture Arrangement & Relocation Technician)!

item.title: Skul: The Hero Slayer
item.description: Guide 'Skul' on his quest to single-handedly take on the Imperial Army and rescue his King from captivity, in an action-packed rogue-lite 2D platformer for the ages.

item.title: Tales of ARISE
item.description: 300 years of tyranny. A mysterious mask. Lost pain and memories. Wield the Blazing Sword and join a mysterious, untouchable girl to fight your oppressors. Experience a tale of liberation, featuring characters with next-gen graphical expressiveness!

item.title: Tales of Berseria Remastered
item.description: Tales of Berseria returns with enhanced playability and quality-of-life enhancements! Join Velvet on her journey for vengeance, along with her cast of eccentric companions, as they sail through the archipelago which comprises the kingdom of Midgand.

item.title: Tales of Graces f Remastered
item.description: Tales of Graces f is back with a beautiful and easier-to-play version! The game also includes Lineage and Legacies, an after-story to the main scenario!

item.title: Tales of Symphonia
item.description: FIRST TIME ON STEAM – Based on the PlayStation®3 port of the original GameCube game, this RPG classic is finally available for PC.

item.title: Tales of Vesperia: Definitive Edition
item.description: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of Tales of Vesperia and the return of this fan-favorite with the Definitive Edition!

item.title: Tales of Xillia Remastered
item.description: Experience Tales of Xillia, remastered for the first time ever. Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.

item.title: Tales of Zestiria
item.description: In a world torn by war and political skirmishes, accept the burden of the Shepherd and fight human darkness to protect your world from Malevolence and reunite humans and Seraphim.

item.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
item.description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge reunites Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael as they kick shell in a beautifully realized beat ’em up.

item.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Dimension Shellshock
item.description: Chaos! The Neutrinos crash the Turtles’ latest pizza party! The teenagers from Dimension X are in dire need of help: Shredder is seeking to conquer the multiverse itself!

item.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Radical Reptiles
item.description: A powerhouse duo teams up with the Turtles for another bodacious ride!

item.title: The Casting of Frank Stone™
item.description: The shadow of Frank Stone looms over Cedar Hills, a town forever altered by his violent past. As a group of young friends are about to discover, Stone’s blood-soaked legacy cuts deep, leaving scars across families, generations, and the very fabric of reality itself.

item.title: Two Point Campus
item.description: Build the university of your dreams with Two Point Campus, the sim with a twist from the makers of Two Point Hospital. Build, hire staff and run an academic institution packed with wild courses.

item.title: Two Point Hospital
item.description: Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.

item.title: Age of Wonders 4
item.description: Rule a fantasy realm of your own design! Explore new magical realms in Age of Wonders’ signature blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat. Control a faction that grows and changes as you expand your empire with each turn!

item.title: City Car Driving
item.description: City Car Driving – realistic car driving simulator, which will help you master the basic skills of the car driving in various traffic conditions, with plunging into the environment most closely resembling the real one.

item.title: COPA CITY
item.description: An economic strategy where top football clubs entrust you with organizing their matches. Build in the city, manage its structures and stadium, provide entertainment, food, and security for fans. Your success is measured by Match Readiness.

item.title: Dead by Daylight
item.description: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Resident Evil Chapter
item.description: Resident Evil is a new Chapter for Dead by Daylight. It includes a Killer, Nemesis; two Survivors, Leon S. Kennedy and Jill Valentine; and a new map. Purchasing the add-on unlocks the new Killer, both Survivors, and an exclusive universal Charm.

item.title: Dead by Daylight - Resident Evil: PROJECT W Chapter
item.description: Only those deemed worthy of Uroboros can achieve true potential. Dead by Daylight: Resident Evil: PROJECT W features a new Killer – Albert Wesker, The Mastermind – and new Survivors Ada Wong and Rebecca Chambers. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive charm: Green Vial.

item.title: Dead by Daylight: The Walking Dead
item.description: Dead by Daylight’s The Walking Dead includes 2 new Survivors, Rick Grimes and Michonne. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Sheriff's Hat badge and Tank in Ruins banner.

item.title: Forts
item.description: Unleash your creativity and strategic prowess in Forts, the exhilarating physics-based RTS! Design, construct, and customize imposing fortresses, bristling with devastating firepower, and blast your opponent’s buildings to rubble!

item.title: Forts - Firebird
item.description: From a humble firefighter to one of the Eagle Empire's most decorated commanders, follow Lisa Del Fuego's journey as she overcomes tragedy, demons and electrifying adversaries to become the illustrious Firebird in Forts' third DLC!

item.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Badlands Set
item.description: Build your own Jurassic World like never before. Nurture generations of awe-inspiring dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

item.title: Medieval Dynasty - Echoes of Nature
item.description: The Echoes of Nature DLC adds a range of outdoor decoration options, focused on natural elements and seasonal variation. It introduces new types of trees, shrubs, hedges, and stone features that can be placed in the environment.

item.title: Regiments
item.description: Regiments is a Real-Time Tactics game set in Germany 1989. The Cold War has gone hot, and the inferno is raging. Lead your Regiment through the fires of conflict and the fog of war. Break through the lines, call in artillery, maneuver, feign retreats, stage defenses, counter-attack. Do not relent.

item.title: Stellaris: Aquatics Species Pack
item.description: Embrace the life of a seafaring civilization as you sail the open expanses of the galaxy with Stellaris' most immersive pack yet. Let a wave of new customizable options for your empire crash into Stellaris, with a treasure trove of new species portraits, ship set, origins and more.

item.title: Two Point Museum
item.description: Curate and manage incredible museums! Explore to discover amazing artifacts. Design and refine the layout, keep staff happy, guests entertained, donations plentiful… and children off the exhibits

item.title: Stellaris: Toxoids Species Pack
item.description: Stake your claim with the hardiest, most stubborn species in Stellaris’ history! Gamble the future of your planets for immediate gains, and make the tough sacrifices necessary to survive a hostile galaxy. Includes New Origins, Civics, Traits, Ship Models and more

item.title: Eldara
item.description: Descend into Eldara, a dark fantasy idle game where every skill, every monster, and every whispered secret carves your path. Train 17 skills, hunt legendary beasts, command loyal pets, and unravel a forgotten realm — at your own pace, with progress that never stops.

item.title: HighFleet
item.description: Battle for survival in the skies of a mysterious future Earth in this unique action-strategy game mixing arcade combat, exploration, management and diplomacy. As giant flying ships wage spectacular aerial warfare, a prophecy tells of one who will save the world – could it be you?

item.title: Into the Radius VR
item.description: Into the Radius is a single-player survival shooter in VR. Explore the Pechorsk zone filled with surreal landscapes and dangerous anomalies. Defend yourself with realistic firearms, recover strange artifacts, scavenge for loot, and uncover the mysteries of this unforgiving dystopian environment.

item.title: M.A.S.S. Builder
item.description: Commander, customize and build your Mechanical Assault Skeleton Suit (M.A.S.S.) and lead the fight against an alien invasion bent on exterminating the human race. The fate of humanity is in your hands.

item.title: Stellaris: Apocalypse
item.description: Stellaris: Apocalypse is a full expansion which redefines stellar warfare for all players with a host of new offensive and defensive options. Destroy entire worlds with terrifying new planet-killer weapons, fight against (or alongside) ruthless space pirates, and maybe discover a few non-violent game features as well.

item.title: Stellaris: Cosmic Storms
item.description: A new phenomenon has been observed around the Galaxy - storms are sweeping through system. Prepare your Empire and brace to face this new upcoming threat, and leverage possibilities that open when your opponents are weakened by it.

item.title: Stellaris: Federations
item.description: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting. With the Stellaris: Federations expansion, players can extend their diplomatic dominion over the galaxy like never before.

item.title: Stellaris: Nemesis
item.description: Nemesis is an expansion to Stellaris in which you will be able to determine the fate of a destabilizing galaxy. Adding espionage tools, a path to power as the Galactic Custodian - or the Menace option to become the crisis - Nemesis gives you the most powerful tools ever available in Stellaris.

item.title: Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile
item.description: Death on the Nile is an adventure-detective game, offering a fresh twist on Agatha Christie’s famous story. Set in the lively 1970s, play as Hercule Poirot and detective Jane Royce as they solve two connected mysteries. Dive into a journey filled with intrigue, deception, and unexpected revelations.

item.title: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite
item.description: Lead a platoon of WWII tanks in this immersive TPP and FPP game. Engage in realistic, tactical combat across historic battlefields. Play through campaign or challenge yourself in skirmish mode as either German or US forces.

item.title: Cities: Skylines II
item.description: Raise a city from the ground up and transform it into a thriving metropolis with the most realistic city builder ever. Push your creativity and problem-solving to build on a scale you've never experienced. With deep simulation and a living economy, this is world-building without limits.

item.title: Cities: Skylines II - Bridges & Ports
item.description: Discover the world of possibility where city meets sea. Build with new bridges, customize your port, and dive into new marine industries. Your waterfront. Leveled up.

item.title: Cruelty Squad
item.description: An immersive power fantasy simulator with tactical stealth elements set in a sewage infused garbage world

item.title: Die in the Dungeon
item.description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

item.title: DJMAX RESPECT V
item.description: DJMAX RESPECT V is the latest installment from the creators of the critically acclaimed rhythm game franchise ‘DJMAX.’ Experience tracks from popular artists such as Marshmello, Porter Robinson, and Yukika, exclusive Full HD Music Videos, online multiplayer, new game modes, and more!

item.title: Eastshade
item.description: You are a traveling painter, exploring the island of Eastshade. Capture the world on canvas using your artist’s easel. Talk to the inhabitants to learn about their lives. Make friends and help those in need. Visit cities, scale summits, unearth mysteries, and discover forgotten places!

item.title: Escape from Ever After
item.description: Fight against capitalism in this satirical adventure RPG! When a greedy megacorp from the real world starts taking over fairytales for their cheap labor, a newly-hired storybook hero must climb the corporate ladder, rally together other disgruntled employees, and fight back!

item.title: Far Cry 3
item.description: Discover the dark secrets of a lawless island ruled by violence and take the fight to the enemy as you try to escape. You’ll need more than luck to escape alive!

item.title: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged
item.description: The world’s raddest cars are back and taking the fun to the next level! Race over 130 vehicles with crazy new mechanics and even more vehicle types. Plus, build your tracks with stunning new environments and different game modes to have fun off and online!

item.title: Into the Radius 2
item.description: Into the Radius 2 is an immersive VR survival shooter, set in a realm of surreal landscapes and deadly entities known as Pechorsk Anomaly. Arm yourself with realistic weapons and venture deeper into the mysteries that lie within, either solo or with a friend by your side.

item.title: Mini Cozy Room: Lo-Fi
item.description: Create Your Own Cozy Workspace! Mini Cozy Room : Lo-Fi is a productivity game blending relaxing Lo-Fi music with room decoration. Cute avatars, pets, desktop memos, to-do lists, and a Pomodoro timer help boost your focus. Feeling lonely? Work together with friends in multiplayer mode.

item.title: MOLE
item.description: Pilot the MOLE, a monstrous post-war drilling machine built to descend deep below the Slavic soil. Fix failing systems, follow voices of the dead, and pray you can survive whatever is sharing your coffin. Will the vessel or your mind break first?

item.title: No More Room in Hell 2
item.description: No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense 8 player zombie shooter. Overcome the endless undead. Avoid infection. Survive hell together.

item.title: Sid Meier's Civilization® V
item.description: Create, discover, and download new player-created maps, scenarios, interfaces, and more!

item.title: Sid Meier's Civilization® VI: Gathering Storm
item.description: Civilization VI: Gathering Storm introduces an active planet where geology and climatology present unique new challenges. The second expansion to Civilization VI adds new Environmental Effects, Engineering Projects, Power and Consumable Resources, as well as the World Congress and a new Diplomatic Victory.

item.title: Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI
item.description: Expand your empire, advance your culture and go head-to-head against history’s greatest leaders. Will your civilization stand the test of time?

item.title: Songs of Syx
item.description: Songs of Syx is a fantasy city-builder with vast battles simulating thousands of citizens and soldiers. Start off as a small village and build, scheme, and fight your way towards a mighty empire. The mechanics are deep and true to life, where tiny events can spiral into the collapse of kingdoms.

item.title: Split Fiction
item.description: Embrace mind-blowing moments as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction, a boundary-pushing co-op adventure.

item.title: Stellaris
item.description: Explore a galaxy full of wonders in this sci-fi grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studios. Interact with diverse alien races, discover strange new worlds with unexpected events and expand the reach of your empire. Each new adventure holds almost limitless possibilities.

item.title: Stellaris: Astral Planes
item.description: NEW CORE SYSTEMS AND TECHNOLOGIES. NEW PLANES TO EXPLORE. NEW BRANCHING NARRATIVES.

item.title: Stellaris: BioGenesis
item.description: Take command of the forces of life itself in Stellaris: BioGenesis. Engineer living ships, terraform entire ecosystems, and wield advanced genetic tools to shape the destiny of your empire. Will you create a utopia of adaptation and growth or weaponize biology to dominate the stars?

item.title: Stellaris: First Contact Story Pack
item.description: Features of First Contact include*: NEW ORIGINS Broken Shackles Payback Fear of the Dark NEW PRE-FTL INTERACTION OPTIONS That allow for a broader range of interactions with pre-FTL civilizations CLOAKING TECHNOLOGY Nobody saw this feature coming! *Some features may require content sold separately

item.title: Stellaris: Galactic Paragons
item.description: Add Galactic Paragons to your empires and experience a new level of character and story as great leaders follow your lead to the stars. With exclusive additions to the all-new Council mechanic, leaders who you can shape to amplify the vision for your empire, new civics and more.

item.title: Stellaris: Grand Archive Story Pack
item.description: In the Grand Archive Story Pack, uncover and showcase the rarest treasures across the cosmos—both living and inanimate.

item.title: Stellaris: Infernals Species Pack
item.description: Forge your destiny in the Stellaris: Infernals Species Pack. Adapted to relentless heat and volatile landscapes, you wield the power of extreme environments to reshape the galaxy. Will your empire thrive in the heat, or be consumed by the very forces it seeks to command?

item.title: Stellaris: MegaCorp
item.description: Stellaris: MegaCorp is the latest full expansion for Paradox Development Studio’s iconic sci-fi grand strategy game, which has players ushering in an era of prosperity and profit on a galactic scale. In this economy-focused expansion, players can become the CEO of a powerful corporate empire to expand operations across the stars.

item.title: Stellaris: Overlord
item.description: Realize your Grand Design Overlord, a new full expansion for Stellaris, grants access to new features designed to unlock the next level of your empire. New mechanics to specialize your vassals’ roles within your empire and new magnificent megastructures to project your power further, faster.

item.title: Stellaris: Shadows of the Shroud
item.description: The psionic plane holds untold power—but at what cost? Shadows of the Shroud is a complete overhaul of the Psionic Ascension path, introducing new moral dilemmas, patron allegiances, and the ever-present temptation of ultimate destruction.

item.title: Stellaris: The Machine Age
item.description: It is an age of technological glory, rapid social change, and unbridled ambition… But in the depths of space, a danger unlike any before encountered is about to emerge, a looming threat that will throw the very meaning of life into question.Welcome to The Machine Age!

item.title: Stoneshard
item.description: Stoneshard is a hardcore turn-based RPG about the harsh life of a medieval mercenary: travel with your own caravan, descend into procedurally generated dungeons, learn new skills, survive hunger and injuries - and remember, every mistake can mean death and loss of progress.

item.title: TCG Card Shop Simulator
item.description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

item.title: Tiny Terraces
item.description: A cozy idle farming game, watch tiny guys do tasks around the terrace, expand, progress, and decorate your Tiny Terrace.

item.title: VOIN
item.description: Crafted by a solo developer, VOIN is a first-person hack-and-slash. Cleave through hordes of enemies in fast-paced combat. Explore dark fantasy realms filled with secrets and dangers. Discover powerful gear and weapons, and face menacing bosses in your quest to cleanse a broken world.

item.title: Wingspan
item.description: Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.

item.title: Winter Burrow
item.description: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

item.title: The Red Lantern
item.description: The Red Lantern is a narrative, dog sledding game about survival. You play as the Musher who, along with her team of 5 sled dogs, must find her way home. Care for your dogs, discover their stories, and learn how to navigate the unknowns of the Alaskan wilderness and prepare for your new life.
